race.title: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Nursery
race.verdict: DIVINE RHYTHM may well have gone backwards from an encouraging debut last time, but a couple of in-frame efforts mean he can make this quick switch to nurseries. In top hands switched to all-weather, he gets the verdict over Q T Boy , who went close to doubling his tally at Bath recently and now makes his all-weather debut. The experienced Global Success rounds off the shortlist. DIVINE RHYTHM (IRE) Q T BOY GLOBAL SUCCESS (IRE)
